basic_details.job_title: IGKV Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 6 Junior Research Fellow, Field Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV), Raipur, has opened six contractual posts under the project "Establishment of Centre of Excellence on Nuclear Agriculture & Food Processing": two Junior Research Fellows (JRF), one Radiation Safety Officer (RSO), two Field Assistants (FA) and one Lab Attendant (LA). JRF and RSO get Rs. 37000 + HRA per month, Field Assistant gets Rs. 18000 per month (fixed) and Lab Attendant gets Rs. 16615 per month (fixed). The posts last up to the project duration or termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The completed application form must reach the Offi

age_limit.details: The age limit printed in the notice is minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age.

qualification.details: Diploma in Engineering/BSc./MSc./Degree in Engineering/M.Tech., plus one of the following: | Training course on Radiation Safety aspects of Gamma Irradiation Chambers Post MSc. Diploma in Radiological Physics Training course on Radiation Safety Aspects in Research Application of Ionizing Radiation RSO Training for Gamma Radiation Processing Facilities Training course on Radiation Safety Aspects

how_to_apply: Use the form for your post given with the notice: Annexure-I for JRF, Annexure-II for RSO, Annexure-III for FA and Annexure-IV for LA.
Affix a self-attested passport photograph on the form.

Fill in the details the form asks for: name (block letters), father's or husband's name, permanent address, email ID, mobile number, date of birth (as per SSC certificate), category (UR/OBC/SC/ST), gender and domicile.
Fill in the academic qualifications table and the sections on awards, publications, experience and extracurricular activities (NCC/NSS/Sports/University Band), attaching self-attested proof for each.
Sign the declaration with date and place.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates and related documents.
Send the application by registered post, speed post or by hand to: Office of the Director Research Services, Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya, Raipur- 492012 (C.G.)
The application must reach on or before 23 November 2026 (5.30 pm). Applications reaching after the due date will not be considered in any condition, and incomplete applications will be rejected.

The experience section differs by form: the JRF form asks for experience as RA/SRF/JRF/TA/Farm Manager etc. in Government institutions; the RSO form asks for experience in the relevant field in Government or private institutions; the FA and LA forms ask for experience in a Central/State Government department or corporation, institute, board, university or authority of Government. The JRF form also has a Ph.D row and the RSO form a "Radiation Professional Education" row in the qualifications table.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to shortlisted candidates for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification; a shortlisted candidate who canvasses will not be interviewed by the committee. The selected candidate will not be entitled to claim regular appointment or absorption in the Institute. Non-maintenance of discipline and failure to perform the assigned duties will make the JRF/RSO/Field Assistant/Lab Attendant liable for termination during the appointment period as per IGKV rule and ICAR guidelines. The declaration in the form states that candidature or appointment may be cancelled if any information is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or ineligibility is detected before or after interview/selection. Updates will be posted on the IGKV website, www.igkv.ac.in.

content_sections.heading: About IGKV
content_sections.text: Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya is an agricultural university at Krishak Nagar, Raipur, Chhattisgarh. This recruitment is run by its Directorate of Research Services for the project "Establishment of Centre of Excellence on Nuclear Agriculture & Food Processing". The Directorate can be reached at [email protected] and Tel & Fax 0771-2443035.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: IGKV has notified 6 posts in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Diploma in Engineering/BSc./MSc./Degree in Engineering/M.Tech., plus one of the following: Training course on Radiation Safety aspects of Gamma Irradiation Chambers Post MSc. Diploma in Radiological Physics Training course on Radiation Safety Aspects in Research Application of Ionizing Radiation RSO Training for Gamma Radiation Processing Facilities Training course on Radiation Safety Aspects The age limit printed in the notice is minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged/Ex-Serviceman/Women candidates and CG domicile will be given as per VV Rules/CG Gov. rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. (Ag.) in Genetics and Plant Breeding from a recognized university

rows.desirable: Working experience in handling of Gamma Irradiation Chamber facility and Radiation Safety Aspects

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow and Radiation Safety Officer: Rs. 37000 + HRA per month. Field Assistant: fixed emoluments of Rs. 18000 per month as per V.V. rules. Lab Attendant: fixed emoluments of Rs. 16615 per month as per V.V. rules. No HRA will be paid to Field Assistant and Lab Attendant. The candidate cannot claim any increment. All positions are purely temporary, filled on a contractual basis, time bound and non-regular, and co-terminus with the project. The appointment of JRF and RSO is subject to the ICAR guidelines in memorandum F. No.: Agril.Edn.01(12)/2023-A&P(e-251411) dated 07/12/2023 and F.No.:Agri.Edn. 1-06/2020-A&P dated 04.12.2020. The appointment of FA and LA is subject to the VV guidelines in S. No./Est.-04/File No.-114/2023/6620 dated 8/12/2023 and S. No./Est.-04/File No.-114/2020/6414 dated 20/01/2020.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGKV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Use the form for your post given with the notice: Annexure-I for JRF, Annexure-II for RSO, Annexure-III for FA and Annexure-IV for LA. Affix a self-attested passport photograph on the form. Fill in the details the form asks for: name (block letters), father's or husband's name, permanent address, email ID, mobile number, date of birth (as per SSC certificate), category (UR/OBC/SC/ST), gender and domicile. Fill in the academic qualifications table and the sections on awards, publications, experience and extracurricular activities (NCC/NSS/Sports/University Band), attaching self-attested proof for each. Sign the declaration with date and place. Attach self-attested copies of certificates and related documents. Send the application by registered post, speed post or by hand to: Office of the Director Research Services, Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya, Raipur- 492012 (C.G.) The application must reach on or before 23 November 2026 (5.30 pm). Applications reaching after the due date will not be considered in any condition, and incomplete applications will be rejected. The experience section differs by form: the JRF form asks for experience as RA/SRF/JRF/TA/Farm Manager etc. in Government institutions; the RSO form asks for experience in the relevant field in Government or private institutions; the FA and LA forms ask for experience in a Central/State Government department or corporation, institute, board, university or authority of Government. The JRF form also has a Ph.D row and the RSO form a "Radiation Professional Education" row in the qualifications table.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow and Radiation Safety Officer: selection based on academic performance and interview. Field Assistant and Lab Attendant: direct recruitment based on score card as per the guidelines of V.V. (Est.-04/File No.-114/2023/6620 dated 8/12/2023 and Est.-04/File No.-114/2020/6414 dated 20/01/2020). The list of eligible and not eligible candidates for interview will be uploaded on the IGKV website on 27 November 2026. Personal interview for JRF and RSO: 30 November 2026 at 11.00 am onwards. Reporting time for document verification: one hour prior to interview time. Venue of personal interview for JRF/RSO: Seminar Hall, Director of Research Services, IGKV, Raipur. Candidates must bring all original documents/certificates for verification during the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IGKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts: 2 Junior Research Fellow, 1 Radiation Safety Officer, 2 Field Assistant and 1 Lab Attendant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Director Research Services, IGKV, Raipur on or before 23 November 2026 (5.30 pm); late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IGKV JRF post?
faq.answer: JRF needs M.Sc. (Ag.) in Genetics and Plant Breeding from a recognized university. Field Assistant and Lab Attendant need BSc. (Ag.)/BSc(Hort.).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice prints a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 35 years, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged/Ex-Serviceman/Women candidates and CG domicile as per VV Rules/CG Gov. rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: JRF and RSO get Rs. 37000 + HRA per month, Field Assistant gets Rs. 18000 per month (fixed) and Lab Attendant gets Rs. 16615 per month (fixed).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid to Field Assistant and Lab Attendant?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no HRA will be paid to Field Assistant and Lab Attendant; HRA is added only for JRF and RSO.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the annexure form for your post, attach self-attested certificates and send it by registered post, speed post or by hand to Office of the Director Research Services, Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya, Raipur- 492012 (C.G.).

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: JRF and RSO are selected on academic performance and interview; Field Assistant and Lab Attendant are selected by direct recruitment based on a score card as per V.V. guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. When and where is the interview for JRF and RSO?
faq.answer: The interview is on 30 November 2026 at 11.00 am onwards in the Seminar Hall, Director of Research Services, IGKV, Raipur, with reporting one hour earlier for document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the project, and the selected candidate cannot claim regular appointment or absorption.
